WHAT WAS ADDED IN v1.1
----------------------
Backend
  • Google ID-token verification (JWKS, aud, iss, exp, email_verified) + account linking
  • Guest browsing middleware with an admin switch
  • Device/push token registry (Firebase-ready)
  • Per-video download permission + token-protected streaming download
  • Live streams (create/start/end, ingest credentials) + polling live chat
  • Copyright/DMCA claim API and admin review queue
  • Platform module: downloads, live, ad placements, monetization profiles
  • New permissions: auth.manage, copyright.manage, live.manage, platform.manage
  • Route fixes: channels/mine shadowing, numeric constraints on /videos/{id},
    /shorts/{id}, /live-streams/{id}, download auth

Android
  • Google sign-in button (appears when enabled by the admin)
  • Guest browsing ("Browse as guest") when guest mode is on
  • Sign-in gate sheet for like, subscribe, comment, upload, download
  • Channel creation wizard; upload blocked until a channel exists
  • Download button for allowed videos + Downloads screen with offline player
  • Config-driven feature flags (downloads, live, guest mode, Google client ID)

KNOWN LIMITATIONS (verified, not hidden)
-----------------------------------------
  • Google sign-in needs a real Android OAuth client (package + SHA-1 above) and a
    Web client ID configured in Admin → Authentication. Without them Google returns
    error 10/12500; the app shows a readable message. Not end-to-end testable here.
  • Live viewing/chat UI is not part of the Android app in this build; the API and
    admin moderation are complete and tested.
  • FFmpeg is not installed on the build machine, so automatic thumbnails/duration
    probing/HLS conversion were not exercised. Uploads still succeed; the admin panel
    reports FFmpeg availability instead of pretending.
  • Downloads are saved to the app's private documents folder (no storage chooser).
  • pdo_sqlite is missing in this environment, so the PHPUnit suite covers only
    DB-independent tests; API behaviour was verified against the live MySQL schema.
  • Release builds use the Android debug key. Create a keystore and update
    android/key.properties before publishing to Play Store.
